news.title: Warrants outline extreme scope of physical abuse in death of 4-year-old Atlanta boy and serious injuries to his brother
news.summary: The boys' caretaker is charged with murder in the death of Cobee Cooks and another woman is charged as a party to the crime.

news.title: Man arrested after home shot up with children inside
news.summary: A 50-year-old man was arrested Thursday after authorities say he shot up a home in Cherokee County earlier in the week.

news.title: GBI identifies driver shot, killed by Atlanta police after SUV rammed patrol vehicles
news.summary: Police said officers were attempting to arrest another person on a domestic violence-related warrant when the shooting occurred.

news.title: Cartersville man arrested after drive-by shooting at Cherokee County home with children inside, police say
news.summary: Taconda Lashad Bush, 50, faces aggravated assault and stalking charges following a shooting on McCollum Way.

news.title: ‘Bubbly ray of light:’ 2nd grader killed in crash
news.summary: A 7-year-old girl who “impacted the lives of everyone” is being mourned by her family, classmates and the Marietta community after she was killed in a crash earlier this week.

news.title: 3 people escape East Point house fire, 1 injured
news.summary: Three people escaped a house fire on Washington Road in East Point, but at least one person was injured after flames engulfed part of the home.

news.title: 'I killed him': Suspect accused of killing man he believed was sleeping with his wife at Doraville restaurant
news.summary: Officers stopped the truck and detained Roman-Cortez. During the encounter, he reportedly told officers, “I shot him, I killed him.”
